items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jackie and I got to know each other very well later on. We were real buddies.

ctx.x: There was a drummer named Jackie Mills, later on.
Oh Jackie, Jackie and I were roommates, yeah, that was later, that was after I left the band, Jackie came in. Jackie and I got to know each other very well later on. We were real buddies.
Was Serge Chaloff there or is that before your time.
